Metadata.Name: 4 Column Demo
Metadata.Description: Demonstrates a 4-column entry form with Info Text labels. Submitter fills the intake form in the portal; data passes through and pre-fills the staff review task.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Intake Form
Step.Description: Submitter fills out the 4-column intake form

Step.Title: Review Intake
Step.Description: Staff member reviews the submitted intake form. Fields are pre-filled from the entry form data.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-staff","assigned_group_id":"group-staff","description":"The fields below were pre-filled automatically from the submitter's entry form."}
